name: Jorah Google readers
description: Read Adam's Google Calendar, Gmail and Contacts, read-only, through gog with a read-only grant. No model reads the data on the way in: gog's JSON is mapped to fixed, capped fields in code (links removed, one-time codes masked). Full detail only in the OpenClaw app's chat (Adam's decision D4); elsewhere counts and times. Every tool marks the chat as having read outside text (jorah-guard).

gogHome.description: gog's own home: config, file keyring with the read-only token

passwordFile.description: The file keyring's password, mode 600, read per call. Never the password itself

account.description: A gog account alias; the address stays in gog's own config

detailChannels.description: Channels that get full detail (D4: the OpenClaw app's chat). All others get counts and times
